payload.core_mechanism_summary: Iterate over possible number of segments (divisors of total sum), for each check if array can be partitioned into contiguous segments with equal sum via greedy left-to-right scan, and track minimal max segment length.
payload.rationale: The solution exhaustively tries all valid segment counts (up to n), verifying each with a linear-time greedy partition. No greedy choice is used to directly optimize; it's brute force over candidate parameters.
